items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1961-04-11
items.q: Jeremy and his women would get him to go out. We had a big job, you know. We'd go out for a week.

ctx.x: Oh, he was good. That guy could play like anything.

He drank hard to get along with that time, you know. When he was sober, it was all right. But if he felt like drinking and didn't get what kind of job you have, he'd just go on to sleep and wouldn't send nobody. I remember once we had to go to Kenwood to play, and I don't know what's going to do. I don't know what's going to do. I don't know what's going to do. I remember once we had to go to Kenwood to play, and I live uptown, and we'd go down way down around Esplanade Street, and Jeremy and his women would get…
Must have been an awfully good going up for everyone. Buddy? Does anybody sound anything like Buddy?
